Normal Anatomy and Physiology 
of the Endocrine System
Many functional interactions take place among the various
ductless glands (see Figure 17.1) that make up the endocrine 
system.1 Th is chapter will focus only on endocrine glands and
disorders related to nutrition and nutritional status.
